summary: Verified the onboarding tour flow on the Dilmaç room screen at http://localhost:4202/dilmac/oda/test123 (mobile viewport 390x844). Cleared localStorage, accepted tour invite, then advanced through all 7 steps. The reported bug ('Bu adım bu ekranda görünmüyor' / '.tour-backdrop.plain' fallback card) does NOT reproduce anymore. Every step showed the correct title, spotlight (.tour-spot) aligned to the correct target element, and no fallback backdrop. After step 7 the 'Mission complete!' card with confetti and chip list appeared as expected. Fix (adding data-tour attributes to auto/voice/keyboard/room buttons in RoomScreen.tsx) is confirmed working.

rca of the issue: Root cause (already fixed by main agent): 4 of the 7 tour target elements in RoomScreen.tsx were missing their data-tour attributes (auto, voice, keyboard, room). Tour.tsx measure() couldn't locate them and fell back to the '.tour-backdrop.plain' 'This step is not visible on this screen' card. After adding the attributes at the referenced lines, all querySelector lookups succeed and the spotlight renders correctly. Verified via automated Playwright walkthrough of all 7 steps.
